description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the second Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Thassa's Oracle trigger, causing you to win the game.
